notes.title: Project N Update (Demo Available)
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/7IzNuFy.gif[/img]
It's been ages since we posted an update here about the "Project N". Partly because, the game is a big departure from FS and we didn't want to bombard you with irrelevant information. 

So, why arew we posting irrelevant info now? Well, we believe that there might be a handful of people who are interested in our work regardless of the genre, and as it's getting closer to a release date, it would be unfair to keep them in the dark. 

If you only interested in Frozen State you can stop reading here, otherwise let me show what "Project N" has turned into. 

"Project N" is now called Mist Hunter and it's fats-paced, colorful,  FPS roguelite with magic weapons and weird enemies. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6244141/0a620a9c645df4894a4fa30995b8835e90d45259.png[/img]

Currently, we've made two absolutely different from each other modes:

[h1]The Summoning [/h1]- endless arena mode where you can practice and hone your skill in quick fights, and compete for the highest score on the leaderboard.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GOygWUj.gif[/img]

[h1]Nexus [/h1]- is a dungeon crawler and it has completely different flow with labyrinth-like levels, secrets and bosses.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M4ee9q0.gif[/img]


If it's your kind of games you can try the both modes out in the demo. https://store.steampowered.com/app/937870/Mist_Hunter/

Any feedback is much appreciated, and if you want to stay tuned you can follow the Mist Hunter page. We'll be posting frequent updates there. 

Cheers,
Alex and Anton

notes.title: Progress Update "Project N"
notes.content:
Hey guys,
 
Apologies for a rather long gap between the updates. It’s been so much work that I didn’t even notice how the time just flew by. I’ve been throwing some gifs on reddit pretty regularly, but haven’t given any updates on where we are and how everything is going. 
 
[h1]The progress[/h1]
 
As the core idea gradually taking up a more defined form, we are cutting down things that we think might not work together or just simply too ambitious for us. Yeap, we’ve learnt this lesson the hard way. 
 
After many discussions we decided to drop the 4-weapon slot system. I think, with this loadouts, where you could sort of define your own character build,  we wanted to bring something new, but in reality it would clash with the fast-paced nature of the game. Any kind of interaction with the inventory to swap the gun in the middle of a fight would inevitably slow the pace or, what in my opinion even worse, would require you to be more defencive. We want you to feel powerful, reckless and be in control of the battle. You are a hunter and your enemies is your prey. 
 
Besides, to justify the loadouts we would need a big variety of weapons, otherwise it becomes pointless. And as I said in the beginning, we know our limits. It takes me about 60-80 hours to make a gun model, from a concept stage to its final, textured model with vfx and animations. Even twenty guns would be roughly about 1500 hours. In days it’s almost two months of ceaseless work without sleep and breaks. In real life those 2 months will easily stretch into 4-5 in the best scenario. And it’s just weapons. For a game you need enemies, levels, environment art, vfx  and so on and on and on. That’s why many indie games take years to make. 
 
Knowing all that, we reduced the number of weapons to seven. Each with a secondary fire mode and a distinct role in the gameplay. 
 
This is what we have so far:
 
1) The basic handgun: Primary mode - rapid fire, not very accurate, close to mid range.  
 Secondary mode - large, relatively slow projectile that can slow enemies.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4kxfRaY.gif[/img]
 
2) Shotgun: Primary mode - slow, large spread, shot to mid range. Secondary - a fast projectile that explodes spawning bouncing shrapnel.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CcqJi6C.gif[/img]
 
3) Machine gun: Primary mode - very fast, good accuracy, mid range. Secondary - grenade launcher, explode on impact, average damage.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/u2scg1K.gif[/img]
 
4) Railgun: Primary mode - slow, perfect accuracy, long range, projectile can bounce of the surface and change direction. Secondary - scope.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/KPL8bSV.gif[/img]
 
5) Plasma rifle: Primary mode - slow projectiles, high damage, close to mid range. Secondary - energy beam, fast, instant hit, gradually builds up damage with time.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zMGAsGQ.gif[/img]
 
6) Rocket launcher: Primary mode - fast projectile, high direct and splash damage, large radius. Secondary - grenade launcher with bouncing projectiles.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/77mKQT2.gif[/img]
 
7) Plasma shotgun: - huge spread, high damage, close distance. Secondary - heat wave, very close range, massive damage.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Tnajtwb.gif[/img]
 
As you can see, many of the models are untextured and don’t have animations. It helps to iterate quickly and change design without being too attached to your work. 
 
These is our first iteration and I’m sure the guns’ firing modes will change as the first feedback starts to come in. 
 
 
[h1]Enemies[/h1]
 
Designing our enemies we’re trying to follow a simple design principle inspired by chess. 
In chess every piece has its own, unique set of move/attack patterns. If you look at each piece by itself, their patterns pretty simple and straightforward. Yet the game is very deep and complex due to a massive number of possible combinations those pieces can occupy the board. 
 
If we translate it into the dimension of video games, with clear patterns and in the right combination even a simple AI can create interesting and complex situations. 
 
So, for the last few weeks, my priority has switched from guns to enemies. 
 
I’ve fully finished  two more enemy types: the  Oracle and the Knight. And just started a new one, which I call the Restless Sleeper. Though it is more an environmental hazard, than an ordinary enemy.  
 
 
 
 
 
[img]https://i.redditmedia.com/HaVml2kzNpbxp2HvG55bjUWw_mlNHNpFHxLsLZkt8Uc.png?w=633&s=4e577368fbfa710eccec5af23df48356 [/img]
 
 
 
Oracle - is a slow flying head that casts large orbs of energy.  
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EWiaS8j.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HmgdrpC.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tR6LFpx.gif[/img]
 
The Knight - has two types of  attacks. Her main is wide, rapid sword slashes. And If you gain a large distance there is a chance that she’ll toss a grenade at you. 
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/DdtyhOh.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/GZ8PCsp.gif[/img]
 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/tM8pPFC.gif[/img]
 
And the family photo
 
[img]https://i.redd.it/nzd50ykbe30z.jpg[/img]
 
 
There is some lore behind each of them and how they all come together, but I want to keep it for the game)
 
 
Meanwhile, Anton has re-written and optimized the code for our procedural test levels, which will be our playground for testing the core mechanics. The system is relatively simple. It uses hand-made rooms and put them together in a particular order. Similar to Spelunky. 
 
However, it’s NOT a rogue-lite. This procedural part will eventually become a separate mode where you’d be able to generate a level for a quick play.
 
  
 
Ok, what else…. Oh, yes! We’ve made gibs!
It’s actually pretty fun, gory, and maybe slightly over the top, but it completely changes how the gunplay feels.
 
This gif is a bit old, and we’ve already changed a few things, but it gives the idea) 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/khPMYf6.gif[/img]
 
 
 
I think, this is all for today.
 
Thank you for sticking around and making it to the end) 
 
Devs

notes.title: "Project N" and more
notes.content:
Hey guys!

[h1]Frozen State[/h1]
Finally, have time to give you an update. There have been several interesting suggestions on the forum and I'm going to implement them in FS. The suggestions are mostly about re-balancing certain stuff(drops and items spawn) and adding a new crafting recipe. I'll try to make it all done by the next weekend.

[h1]"Project N"[/h1]
The development of the new game is moving at a good pace. For the last couple of months, Anton has been working primarily on a pathfinding system and its editor.  If you don't know what the pathfinding is and what it does, the bast way to explain it would be a thing that helps AI (everything that isn't directly controlled by the player)  navigate on the level. In other words pathfinding is one of the most fundamental technical things in many games.

Unity, like many other third-party engines, offers its own buit-in solution, and it's quiet good. However, it has some limitations that make this, pretty much a one-click solution, unusable for us. So, to make the game we want, we need to start with the tools.

Anton did a great job and came up with a node-based pathfinding system. It's very cool and gives me, as a level designer, a lot of freedom and control. Instead of relying on generated navigational mesh, which to be honest isn't particularly precise, I can paint/erase the paths for AI on the level where I want. I can also edit every node and its parameters to fix problematic areas, or to simply add some variety to how enemies move around.  Besides it also allows to make paths for flying AI, which can navigate throughout any level efficiently. This is how it looks in the editor.

A pathfidning layer for the ground types enemies

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/568dd333dcffcaf4f2d357642ad1c416/tumblr_omo2ghR3Rr1qdp9tto2_1280.jpg[/img]

And another one in exactly same room for the flying types.

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/3468a40f193b8e692f061851f2510408/tumblr_omo2ghR3Rr1qdp9tto1_1280.jpg[/img]

There are a few disadvantages though. One of the most significant is time. All paths on each level must be drawn by hands. It's not as bad as it sounds, but it takes time nonetheless.

A small stress test for the system 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/v2uu8PA.gif[/img]

On my side, I've been working on the visuals, designing, modeling and animating. Simple primitives like cubes and spheres are indispensable for quick prototyping and testing, but at some point you need more complex 3d assets to see how it comes together. These are our first enemies, which you'll be seeing quite a lot from now on.

A Zbrush concept

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/d7f10c6e8eb0df4ab226db2f6aad588a/tumblr_omo2ghR3Rr1qdp9tto4_1280.jpg[/img]

And the actual in-game model inside Unity.

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/06fcd63b1d65b9f83590c8c185c57a02/tumblr_olix0g6knX1qdp9tto1_540.gif[/img]

This fella is still in the concept stage

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/582c792e75cb08662d11fb4dea530ec0/tumblr_omo2ghR3Rr1qdp9tto3_1280.jpg[/img]

We intentionally chose a more stylized, cartoony look. Firstly, because it's a bit faster/simpler in production and as I'm going to make all the assets alone speed is very important. The second reason, I just really enjoy working on something like that. Saturday morning cartoons and anime are a big source of inspiration.

A few guns, which I'm pretty sure change with time

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/487a2985891e3575185ecb1219f19fd3/tumblr_okcow9twQw1qdp9tto1_1280.png[/img]

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/454f302f86e0c4d4d0fc5c79b53beefa/tumblr_ohez7bzF4a1qdp9tto1_400.gif[/img]

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/d1f5b516bf3093fc882f72e011b6d12f/tumblr_ok3b825eme1qdp9tto1_r1_1280.gif[/img]

[img]https://68.media.tumblr.com/bfabaed922e7efafdfc54d68f789b6ed/tumblr_oi65ndnBmZ1qdp9tto1_540.gif[/img]
I know, it's not much and everything isn't final,  but it should give some overall idea about the art direction.



Don't forget to follow us on twitter [b]https://twitter.com/Flox_Studios[/b] or reddit [b]https://www.reddit.com/r/FLOX/[/b]

Thank you,
Alex

notes.title: "Project N"
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/apps/270270/0d61f303fcdb8196c994251b310775890bfe3c49.jpg[/img]


I intended to post this update a week a go, but it took me way more time to finish than I had expected.

[H1]BACK TO WORK[/H1]

While we were on holidays, we received several bug reports mostly regarding some broken achievements( one of them is "alpha" which should be available to everyone), and issues with controller in FS. All those issues will be fixed soon.

Actually, most of the achievements are already fixed, but we’ve found several more bugs which need extra time to fix. I hope we release a beta update next week.


[h1]NEW PROJECT[/h1]

In the last FS update, I mentioned that we had started working on something new and it wasn't related to FS. So, what's the new project?

If you follow us on twitter or reddit you definitely could see some 3D models that would give you a hint. Naturally, you may already figured it out, but if you didn’t, the next genre we’d like to work on is first person shooter.

I know, this is quite a departure from our previous games and a whole new uncharted territory for us as developers. Making our next game in a genre we’ve worked before would be much safer, but as indies we have a luxury of creative freedom and willing to take the risk. Besides, I think with the help of community we can make a great game in any genre.

So, what kind of a fps? Well, the concept is slowly shaping up. Its details will certainly change and evolve over time, but the core is a fast-paced, reckless action with a high ceiling for mastery. All other mechanics are going to be built around this core. The main focus will be single-player, with a high chance of co-op, though much later down the line.

If it’s still vague, try imagine borderlands (minus its gazillion guns and rpg-ish elements) and quake 1 had a baby. It’s not very good to use other games to describe your own, as it may lead to a certain misconception, but at this stage it should give you at least a rough idea of what we have in mind.


[h1]GAME DESIGN AS EXPERIMENT[/h1]

OK, we’ve already established that fps is a new genre with a bunch of unknowns for us. To tackle those unknowns, we want to take a slightly different approach this time and share every process and design ideas from the get-go. That means you’ll be seeing lots of unfinished and unpolished stuff, including our design thoughts and prototypes. - FIXED - character deals (melee) damage being too far away from the target

notes.title: Update - 0.88 build 217
notes.content:
[img]http://floxstudios.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/467_181.png[/img]

Hi there, 

The so long-awaited update is finally here! Thank you all for your patience! 

There have been so many changes that I don’t know where to start, I guess I should begin with the main reason why we even started this big overhaul - the melee combat.

The melee combat, the animations and  the overall controller have been reworked from scratch. Now, next to your health bar (yes the health bar has changed too) you’ve got another bar of  the “quick stamina”, which depletes every time you hit something, dodge or sprint. The quick stamina regenerates on its own when you stay still or even walk. However, if you need to replenish it quickly in the combat you can drink a flask of water and it will restore instantly. 

The dodge - you character can make a small jumps in all four directions to avoid being hit or just for fun of you like jumping around)In order to dodge just press the “Space”, by default the character jumps backwards. But, if you hold any of the “WASD” keys and press the “Space” he will jump in the direction of the pressed key. The jumps does not interpret other animations! So, if you start spamming the Space key in the middle of the attack animation nothing will happen. Also don’t forget to monitor the quick stamina, you cannot dodge when it’s too low.

The Sprint - have replaced the run. It works in exactly the same way (by pressing Caps/Shift) as the run used to work, except your character moves way faster and can sprint for a short period of time. But bare in mind that the sprint speed will depend on the type of weapon you hold in your hands.  While sprinting you can hit the “Space” to make a leap. Now you can jump over very little obstacles, but we’re going to improve it.

The Crouch stance -  have also received a new pack of animations and a few gameplay changes. When you perform a melee attack your character will automatically stand up and hit. Another way to quit the crouch stance quickly is by hitting the Space key, the character will jump back and stand up. Sometimes it can be very handy.

We have also added a bunch of small animations for falls, death, reload and so on. 

The quick stamina bar can be upgraded by leveling up the Endurance, the max level will double the amount of the quick stamina. 

All enemies have been re-balanced, especially the damage and the animations speed to fully employ the new combat system. The human enemies will no longer deal extra damage like bleeding and fractures with bare hands. The friendly NPCs have become tougher and harder to kill, so think twice before you attack them.

There are a few new locations, which contain  the underground bunkers with some really good stuff. The current build has 65 fully explorable locations + some underground mini levels, which is quite a lot.

The docks’ door has been fixed and now can be opened with the key.

The weapon parts are now being  generated along with the other loot, what make it easier to find.

The R key properly rotates the big building objects without canceling the blueprint. 

Visual improvements - the day time became brighter and looks really gorgeous. 

Added subtle snow particles that moves by the wind, they a more visible during the bad weather.

The enemy can be stunned, the stun chance depends on the character's damage and the amount of health of the enemy.  In other words the bigger your damage and the weaker your opponent the higher the chance to get him stunned. We will add the visual indication of the stunned enemy in a few days, for now a stunned enemy will just stand still for a few seconds. 

There are some other small bug fixes and improvements.

As always we are glad to hear your feedback and suggestions. For the next patch we’re going to focus on polishing the existing combat system and making the survival elements deeper.

Thank you,

Devs

notes.content:
Hey there, 

Sorry for a small delay I was visiting my family, and almost entire weekend I didn’t have access to the internet.

A new FS update is live on Steam, and here is the change list.

The hard mode obviously is much harder, your start the game with the absolutely empty inventory. Your health does not replenish during the sleep. The characters can carry two times less weight. Enemies do not have sight cones in focus hearing.

notes.content:
[b]Hey there,[/b]

It’s been a really productive but extremely busy month, especially the last week. We have managed to add more than we had planned, unfortunately not without a small delay. We've added a drivable car, yes-yes, now you can find a car and drive it in real time and not only on the world map. Another very important thing, DO NOT leave the car in the randomly generated location called wilderness, if you run out of fuel and leave it there it will be gone.

The car runs on special fuel which can be found in abandoned cars and garages. However almost every location with buildings has at least one or two fuel cans on it, sometimes they can be hidden. The car has also a roomy boot (trunk) where you can keep a lot of useful stuff and carry it around with you.

Do not forget to turn the engine off leaving the car, otherwise you risk to run out of fuel very quickly.  You can switch the headlights on and off by pressing the “F” button.

Another cool addition is an intro scene that will shed some light on the Frozen State world and the origin of the Hybrids. The subtitles speed was adjusted to our average reading speed, so if you find it too fast or too slow please let us now. -You can disable the Indie Showcase banner in the game settings

-3 New locations

-New Item - Fuel Can

[b]German Localisation[/b]

One of the forum members has helped to translate the game into german, and we are super grateful. However we simply didn’t have time to squeeze it into the current build. Thank you,

notes.title: Update [13] Alpha 0.085 Build 101
notes.content:
Hi all,

New update is on steam and ready to be downloaded.

Some of you already knew that we were working on localisation system which would make possible to support other languages. It wasn’t a trivial task because we had to go through the all line of codes and create links and keys for translation. It’s finally done and works very well you can change languages on the fly without quitting and restarting the game. Currently the game supports two languages English and Russian, but I hope we can expand this list)

If anyone is willing to help us with translation,tomorrow I’m going to put up a thread dedicated for localizations where I put the files and explain how they work.

Another thing that you find in this built is key remapping, of course you could do it before by altering the settings file, but it wasn’t particularly convenient. Now you can bind the keys to your liking from the main menu.

Content wise, I made a new Pharmacy building and a new location with it. The idea behind this is that rare medicine and drugs would have higher spawn rate in pharmacy than in other places. Of course one location is only the beginning and I’m planning to make 4 or 5 of them. 

One of the old locations has gotten a sewage sub-level, which can open you accesses to the previously cut off part of the level. 

We spent a huge amount of time trying to catch the illusive “loading screen bug”, I know I’ve written many time that it been fixed, but there is a lot of things that may cause it, sometimes even a missing comma in an item description or stats can be a reason. However this is easy to find and fix, but this time it is something and judging by your reports it mostly likely to happen when you return to the starting location. So to trace the real cause, we logged some chunks of the code where it may happen and now if it happened we should know where to dig.  So, when you come across this bug, just quit the game and send us your save files (all files in data folder and output log).

Thank you,

Devs

notes.title: Update [9] Alpha 0.080 Build 73
notes.content:
[b]Hi all,[/b]


To begin with, I’d like to thank everyone who was helping us with testing the new controls and for providing so valuable feedback. It was incredibly insightful, thank you!

Majority of the players has agreed that the new control scheme works better and it should become permanent. However we still think that there is room for improvements, and we would like to try a few more things in the future, besides we want to be sure that when the controller support is in place you would have the exactly same experience as if with a mouse and a keyboard.

The freelook mode is still there (to activate press “X”), if you have issues enabling it, try to delete Setting.txt file, it should help.
           



So what is new in this update?



[b]New Hybrids[/b]

Those of you how were playing the so called “Beta” build, might have seen them already, if you haven’t here they are.

The Mother  - a female version of the Gaunt, has less HP and deals less physical damage that her male counterpart, but her poisonous spits have much greater chance to poison your character. 

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/19/18664/thumb_620x2000/NEW_monsters_01-1.jpg[/img]

The Step Daughter -  a fast and deadly hybrid, almost impossible to outrun her on foot, inflicts significant amount of damage with her brutally disfigured, sword-like arms.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/19/18664/thumb_620x2000/NEW_monsters_03-1.jpg[/img]

The Widow - a female hybrid whose face were completely melted off by an acid secreted from the some kind of glands on her head. Her sharp claws cannot penetrate heavy armor, but even a scratch will intoxicate the body and prevent blood from clotting, leading to a death from blood loss. 

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/19/18664/thumb_620x2000/wdowa.jpg[/img] 

The Spine - sometimes even being dismembered, some parts of the hybrids’ bodies can continue to live and evolve as unique, self-contained organisms

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/19/18664/thumb_620x2000/tripod.png[/img] 

The Piecer’s attack and vision distances were slightly nerfed. 

We also decided to increase the amount of ammo generated in the world that you could have slightly better odds  against the new enemies, which are all quite fast.



[b]New Weapons[/b]

So, the energy weapons are finally into the game, though for now, until NPCs are still in work, you can only obtain the energy weapons by killing Gargantua. The drop chance a quite high you won’t need to kill a dozen of them to get a cool gun)

Maser Gun

[img]http://40.media.tumblr.com/c602df2a47975bbb9937360bd9ca3669/tumblr_nkg3ltoJoV1qdp9tto1_250.png[/img]

Maser Handgun

[img]http://40.media.tumblr.com/1c96c9f25b9876f253e29974b7f5fa67/tumblr_nkg3ltoJoV1qdp9tto4_250.png[/img]

B.P.C. - Big Plasma Cannon

[img]http://41.media.tumblr.com/6352236f5befb85345d1e2da9cd97eaa/tumblr_nkg3ltoJoV1qdp9tto3_250.png[/img]

Laser Sniper Rifle

[img]http://40.media.tumblr.com/db93c1dce2f7cdd48512712f0ade1381/tumblr_nkg3ltoJoV1qdp9tto2_250.png[/img]

[b]World[/b]  

The size of the world has grown a bit more again. If we combine all 51 location in one it will be just slightly over 5 square kilometres. 
With the new system of spawners it became possible to randomise entrances in the underground levels, for now it works only in one “Uncharted” location, but as I make more underground levels, I’ll be steadily adding them to the old locations too. 

Misc

Now when you consume a drink, food or a med kit, you’ll get a notification that this item was consumed. It also accompanied with a corresponding sound like chewing or drinking water, it’s not a big thing but provides additional feedback to your action and just feels cool)))

[b]Bugs[/b]

As usual, you all have been super helpful with allocating the bugs. Actually, we fixed a few very serious bugs:

some enemies weren’t saving properly when you travelled from one location to another. It means that whenever you return to a location that you had visited there may be no enemies at all. [Fixed]
inventory list was distorted or appeared like in one line [Fixed]
disassembling multiple items had a bug that could give you hundreds of resources [Fixed]
infinite loading on the Gas Station location [Fixed]
some other minor bugs


[b]VERY IMPORTANT: If you notice that you frame rate dropped significantly, delete the Setting.txt file, for some unknown reason the new version sometimes doesn't wipe the old file and it causes an error which makes a call every frame affecting the performance.[/b] 


Thank you,

Devs

notes.title: Controls Test 2
notes.content:
Good evening everyone,

We made a couple of changes to the controls based upon your suggestions and ideas.

Changes:

- when you start attacking, the character will automatically switch to the walk mode and will return in the run mode when you stop attacking.

- in the run mode, pressing Shift, will make the character switch to the walk mode and turn his sight in the position of the cursor. For example if you need to look back fast while running just move the cursor behind the character’s back and press Shift. He will turn back but will keep moving in the same direction. Personally I find this as the most convenient way of playing.

- Freelook mode. In this mode the camera follows the cursor and rotates around the character as if you had the RMB pressed. To activate this mode press X.

In my opinion, this mode is not as good as it may sound, and requires some work. Mainly because interaction with objects happens only when the cursor is above an object ( a door for instance)  and when you move the cursor the camera moves along with it, all together it feels hectic . We’ve tried many different ways of locking the camera, position it behind the character, make rotation slower, faster and tons of other different things. The only way, we think, would work with this mode, if we get rid of the cursor completely and make a lock-on system.
           

As always we are looking forward to hearing your opinion. 

Thank you,

Devs

notes.title: Update [8] Alpha 0.080 Build 68
notes.content:
[b]Hi all,[/b]

It is Sunday and we have something new for you. Yes, yes it’s a new update with new things and improvements. 

In the previous update, many of you have complained about the changes in the world map. I guess, I should’ve explained the way the new map works and the core changes more thoroughly to avoid the misunderstanding. 

Even though I have given some guides on the forum, I think I should repeat them here in case some of you have missed them. 

So first of all there is no grid, locations’ coordinates are procedurally generated every new game, they can spawn anywhere on the map and they do not snapped to a grid.

The first  click on the map will bring up a small orange square which shows your destination, to start moving you must click (once) INSIDE that orange square. If you make a double click the character will stop. 

Secondly, all ‘permanent’ locations have icons that represent their types, in order to explore these locations you must place the character (orange cross) within the icon borders. If you  press the “Explore” button while being outside the icon, you’ll be spawn on a random location.

The locations’ names, which you will explore if you press the “Explore” button, are displayed just above  the “Explore” button. All random locations are called as - Wilderness.

Thanks to the feedback you all provided we made a few improvements:

-unvisited locations have blue colour
-visited locations are green
-size of the icons was increased
-the fog became transparent showing the map’s outline
-additional icon (blue triangle) to show your cabins
-extra icon for locations with lakes 
-improved procedural generation

[b]More New Stuff[/b]

Some of the old locations has gotten entrances into the new underground sub-locations. At the moment all entrances are static but later we plan to make them procedurally generated.

A few new items

-Soap to wash dirty sheets
-Wrist watch ( shows in-game time)
-Thermometer ( shows outdoor temperature)

“Stained sheets” have a purpose, you would need them to make torches.

“Survivor’s guide mak” is another small, but a very handy addition. It allows you to place marks in  that can be seen on the minimap. You can find them in the Building tab.

The starting location have undergone some minor changes. After some observation, I also decided to increase the attack range of the Piercer, he was a relatively easy target for some skilful players))


The world has grown a little bit more and now consists of 43 locations. A bunch of annoying was fixed and I hope they will not appear again.

As always we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback.


Thank you all,

Devs

[h1][b]Happy New Year![/b][/h1][h1][/h1]

All our team wants to thank you all for the patience and understanding, we really wanted to release this update earlier, but life has its own schedule. 

But we’re back again, thanks to a friend’s PS3 that temporarily sacrificed its hard drive in order to bring our server back to life. If you are not aware of what happened, the short version would be a dead server right on Christmas time which made us delay this update. 

By now, we’ve restored almost everything, the only thing we decided not to include in this build is the hidden underground locations. They are really cool, but require some work to integrate them in the world.
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/19/18664/sde.PNG[/img]

[h1][b]Changelist[/b][/h1]

[b]Map[/b]

There are plenty of new things and improvements but I’d want to start with the world map . This part of the game was revamped completely. Now you have the whole map to explore freely in any order you want with no red zones blocking your way. To make navigation easier, all explorable locations were given special icons which represent their types

[url=http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_vilage.png]

[url=http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_forest.png][img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_forest.png[/img][/url]Forest

[url=http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_industrial.png][img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_industrial.png[/img][/url]Industrial

[url=http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_start.png][img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/m_start.png[/img][/url] Starting location


The world generation system has undergone some serious changes as well. Instead of the fixed coordinates, each location will be spawning procedurally on the world map. Moreover every point on the world map became explorable. This gives us more freedom with random encounters and small events.

[h1][b]Workbench[/b][/h1][h1][/h1]

[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/workb.png[/img]

A long awaited feature - the workbench makes it possible to upgrade weapon and body armour. However to build one, you would need a Set of Tools the number  of which is quite limited in the world. There is always a chance to break an item. The chance depends on your crafting skill and upgrade level. Repairing will slowly degrade the max. durability of an item, and after a certain point  the item may become irreparable. [h1]

[b]Characters[/b][/h1]

The last but not least, Maria has finally joined the game! It’s not an easy character to play, but if you like a sneaky play style and some extra challenge she is the best option. 
Besides the starting HP of all characters has been increased:
 - Ingvar 300 HP
 - Stas 250 HP
 - Maria 180 HP

[h1][b]New Items[/b][/h1] 
Metal Plates
Melee Upgrade Kit
Guns Upgrade Kit
Felt

[h1][b]World[/b][/h1]

39 locations 

Thank you,

Devs 

P.S. Soon we will need a few volunteers with linux machines;)

notes.title: Update [6] Alpha 0.074 Build 52
notes.content:
Hi there,

Alpha 0.074 build 52 has landed! 

In this update we’ve finished work on  bleeding, poisoning, fractures and burns . The enemy have been given new abilities.

-The Jumper -  has 50% chance to inflict bleeding (physical damage was reduced)
-The Piercer - has 50% chance to inflict bleeding, 20% chance to inflict fractures
-The Gaunt - has 30% chance to poison

How to get rid of those negative states. Well, the bleeding can be stopped by using simple Bandages, Germicide Bandages or Zelenka (topical antiseptic), the last one is the least effective. The bandages can be crafted from Clean Sheets, combining CLean Sheets with Zelenka will give you Germicide Bandages with better healing properties.

Pain from fractures can be reduced only by injecting Morphine. This item can be only found in the world, and cannot be crafted.

Poisoning can be fixed in the exactly same way as food poisoning by taking Activated Carbon.

Burns, there are not many ways you can burn yourself, but the most simple one is stepping into the campfire. Yes that’s right, if  you step into open fire your character will begin to lose health points and eventually will get burns. There are no specific item that can help treat the burns, but you can use medkits. The medkits is a universal remedy, they heal all negative factors at once.

The amount of Antrazidol was almost halved, it’s going to be slightly harder to find the “magic pills”, so use them wisely)))

We also made five new locations,what makes the total size of the world about 3 square kilometres. 

The dialog and quest system are almost done, this tools make it possible to start adding NPCs and small quests in the world. 


Thank you all,

Devs

notes.title: UPDATE [2] ALPHA 0.070 BUILD 18
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


We are finishing up the testing and will release the second update tonight ! :)


Change list:

- The world map. It significantly changes the way you explore the world. Instead of jumping straight in the neighbouring location and going through one by one, you can now choose where to travel and what location you want to explore next. It gives much more freedom and strategic choices.  The layout of the map is procedural and changes every play through. 
[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/workd-1024x795.png[/img]

At the moment there are no markers on the map and you cannot place your own, but it will be added in the future updates. 


- New buildings. We replaced the old cabin and added three more ( 4 in total).  Each of the buildings requires different amount of resources to build and has different temperature bonus. In the future some buildings will depend on your crafting skill.

[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/screenshot018-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/screenshot017-1024x576.jpg[/img]

[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/screenshot016-1024x576.jpg[/img]


- Ladders. You may have seen the ladders in some places, but they weren't working. Now you can use them to climb up or over some things.  Active ladders highlighted with purple colour.

[img]http://frozenstate.net/blog/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/fdr-1024x736.png[/img]


- Crafting.  This section has also undergone some changes.  New crafting groups Ammo, Weapon, Survival and Building Materials.

                         Ammo: 3 types of bullets - 9mm, 7.62mm and  12mm
                         Weapon: Handcrafted Axe, One-Shot Gun, Nail Plank
                         Building Materials -  self-explanatory 
                         Survival - campfire and sleeping bag 

In order to craft "Ammo" you'd need to have three main ingredients : "Empty Shells",  "Gunpowder" and "Melted Lead".  The last one is not so easy to obtain, you  have to collect "Old Car Batteries", break them to get "Lead Battery Plates" and melt the plates on fire.

- All body armour can be torn apart for "Cloth Rags".  The amount of the salvaged resource depends on the item's durability.

- All guns were rebalanced, the damage was increased by 10-35 %.  Noise distance of riffles and shotguns increased by 5-8 metres

- The amount of ammo generated in the world was reduced by 30%

- All melee weapons wear off , durability decreases with every hit.

- Snow piles has been changed visually. You can extract snow multiple times from one pile. The amount of piles generated in every location,  reduced by 25%.

- Auto-hints can be disabled in the game options

-  bug fixes.



As always, we are looking forward to hearing your feedback and suggestions.

Thank you,

Devs
